newsitem.title: USA: Hibbett, Memberworks set IPO terms with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Hibbett, Memberworks set IPO terms with SEC.

text.p: Hibbett Sporting Goods Inc and Memberworks have filed preliminary terms for their respective initial public offerings, according to filings made with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Hibbett has filed to offer 2.0 million shares in an estimated price range of $14 to $16 each. The company has proposed to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "HIBB".

Memberworks has filed to offer 2.7 million shares in an estimated filing range of $15 to $17. The company provides membership service programs through credit card issuers in areas such as health, dental, sports, and entertainment.
